description: This file contains TypeScript code defining utility functions and types for mocking Node.js built-in modules during testing. It includes a generic factory type, functions to resolve mock overrides and defaults, and an async function to create mocked modules with optional default exports mirror.

methods.name: function resolveMockOverrides<TModule extends object>( resolveMockOverrides
methods.description: Resolves mock overrides either by invoking a provided factory function or returning a static partial object.

methods.name: function resolveDefaultBase<TModule extends object>(actual: TModule): Record<string, unknown> { resolveDefaultBase
methods.description: Extracts the default export from a module if available, otherwise returns the module itself.

methods.name: export async function mockNodeBuiltinModule<TModule extends object>( mockNodeBuiltinModule
methods.description: Asynchronously loads an actual module and returns a mock version, optionally mirroring overrides to the default export.

ctags.name: defaultExport
ctags.pattern: /^  const defaultExport = (actual as TModule & { default?: unknown }).default;$/

ctags.name: resolveDefaultBase
ctags.pattern: /^function resolveDefaultBase<TModule extends object>(actual: TModule): Record<string, unknown> {$/
